## 3. Bigin by Zoho: best for solo founders and micro-teams

What it does: Bigin is Zoho’s stripped-down, pipeline-focused CRM built specifically for very small teams (1-10 people) that find Zoho CRM too complex.

Best for: Solopreneurs and teams under 10 people who want CRM essentials without the bloat.

Bigin treats your small team like a small team. Most CRMs hand you 200 fields you’ll never use and call it customizable; Bigin gives you maybe 20 and trusts you to know what your business needs. I had a working pipeline, web form, and email sync set up in 15 minutes with zero training.

...

If your team is under 10 people and you’ve outgrown a spreadsheet, Bigin is the cheapest, fastest way to a working CRM. Plan to migrate to Zoho CRM if you cross 20 users or need deep automation.

...

## Final verdict

For most small businesses, Zoho CRM or Pipedrive is the right starting point. Zoho offers depth and customization at a fair price. Pipedrive is the cleanest sales pipeline tool in the category.

If your team is sales-focused, Pipedrive is the better choice. If your workflow is non-standard or you want unlimited users without per-seat pricing, Zite is worth a look. The worst CRM is the one your team won’t use, so prioritize a tool that matches how you actually work.
